methodology.salary: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics. The displayed range is the statewide 10th-to-90th percentile estimate for the occupation, not a district salary schedule or a guaranteed starting-to-maximum range.
methodology.standards: Official state education-agency documentation. Labels distinguish state-specific standards from formal NGSS adoption.
methodology.outcomes: NAEP state snapshots and the official State Profiles data service for public-school students. Raw-score positions use unrounded estimates for the 50 states and District of Columbia; they are always paired with NAEP's statistical comparison because adjacent ranks may not represent meaningful differences.
methodology.working_conditions: NCES National Teacher and Principal Survey is the preferred source. No composite teacher-happiness score is created.

salary.source_label: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics
salary.note: Statewide estimates across employers and regions; local school-division schedules may differ substantially.

standards.summary: Virginia publishes subject-specific Standards of Learning for K-12 instruction.
standards.science: The current VDOE science page includes the 2018 Science SOL for K-Physics and 2025 expanded high-school science standards. This profile does not label Virginia as an NGSS-adoption state.
standards.source_label: Virginia Department of Education K-12 Standards & Instruction

outcomes.note: Average scale scores for public-school students. Scores are context, not a teacher-quality rating.
outcomes.rank_methodology: Competition positions calculated from unrounded 2024 average-score and at-or-above-Proficient estimates for the 50 states and District of Columbia; National public, DoDEA, and Puerto Rico are excluded. Positions do not account for sampling error and must be read with the provider's statistical comparison.
